question: Which of the following I/O devices is a block device?
solution:
**The correct option is (2)**

Tape drive

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nonvolatile mass storage devices called "block devices" provide access to data in any order. Block devices include things like CD-ROMs, floppy discs, and hard drives.
 
• For backup and archiving reasons, a tape drive is a device that stores computer data on magnetic tape.
 
• To back up and recover data, tape drives are always utilized. Despite being much less common than disc drives, tape drives serve a crucial purpose.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**** Mouse:-** A hand-held pointing device called a computer mouse (plural mice, occasionally mice) senses two-dimensional motion in relation to a surface.

**USB port:- **The USB-A connector can charge devices like smartphones and other electronics in addition to connecting USB drives, keyboards, and mice.

**Keyboard:-** Using a keyboard, you can input letters, words, and numbers into your computer.
